description: B2B GTM stack intelligence: search ~400 tools with pricing, compare vendors 2-way or n-way, find stack overlaps (104 hand-verified pairs), run spend audits, map category landscapes, get buyer questions and renewal-negotiation playbooks. Free, no API key, stateless.

findings.recommendation: Tool requests broad permissions (exec/fs/network). Validate input parameters using Enums where possible, and restrict file system operations to explicit allowed directories.
